Name: Kero - Dog From Harvest Moon NES for Adopt n' Skin and Alternative Textures
Author: TerraTerraCotta
Description:
[size=4][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size]
Originally I was hoping to convert a variety of dogs and maybe cats from the other Harvest Moon games for use with Adopt n' Skin. Unfortunately, it seems only the original Kero has a sheet I can work with!
Either way, I was surprised no one had done this yet. Perhaps just as a cute novelty, why not have the original Harvest Moon dog on your farm? I've seen replacers and skins for the classic Harvest Moon Cow. So why not Kero?

Now available for Alternative Textures!

[b]
[u]CREDITS[/u][/b]
Skins were reformatted, tested, and put together by TerraTerraCotta.
[i](These Skins were tested using Adopt N' Skin)
